title: CVE-2026-123218 added to CISA KEV (exploited in the wild)
summary_en: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.
lines: IBM Aspera Faspex: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.
